decisions.summary: Check brief: every finding of one report applied in one message, record commands and tests once
research/CLAUDE.md trimmed to its operative rules (13,290 chars, observed 2026-09-26) under the same headings; full text (45,051 chars at 37c20e57) moved verbatim to docs/research-record-rules.md
decisions.why: Round after digest 23fee4d2, read from the diff 06eac8a2..HEAD only. Every item of the previous BLOCKED list is now in research/CLAUDE.md under its heading: (195) the CITATION link is the full-text view not a library landing page, and the original-language page not an English rendering on no page; what a read copy does NOT say is written where the claim stands, the rest labeled GUESS; settling is never obligatory; the GROUNDS sentence restores on an existing note verbatim; (190) a page named only as silent or unreadable and an unregistered summary-only or withdrawn item stay plain; a new entry records the URL and its READ date; (194) the form holds in body prose and in a SOURCES.html entry; the original is the checker anchor, never a second quote; two footnotes on a sentence resting on two sources; (209) the roster key parenthetical says what the work contributed, never when or how it was read; an absence note provenance is an HTML comment in its li; (229) no engine identifier or check in the spec visible text, and where it rests on no finding it says which: a convention, a calibration against the drawn exhibits, or a guess. The plan figures carry a one-shot label (observed 2026-09-26, len at 37c20e57 and after) and re-measure exactly: wc -m gives 45,051 for the file at 37c20e57 and 13,290 for the current file. With every rule kept and the full reasoning moved verbatim, this is R3 rec 4 as adopted (trim to the operative rules), not a narrowing of it.

decisions.summary: Raster-mode lit-paddy/beads browser check waits for its state with the driver's bounded settles (2 s), assertions unchanged; T39 three runs green
decisions.why: Fixed, not hidden: no skip, xfail, retry or loosened expectation; the asserted tuples are unchanged and a value that never arrives within the bound still fails. A stale read equal to the wanted value could pass, but the original same-tick read passed on the same stale value, so it is no weaker than before.
